verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
You have known our souls in adversity
When we strive against You
You extend Your hand time and time again
From the heights of glory
To the depths of my heart

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
You have bound Yourself to man
Despite his unfaithfulness
You have bound Yourself to man
Despite his unfaithfulness

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You pour out mercy
You open Your heart
You pour out mercy
Reveal Your heart

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
All man’s empty promises
Lie broken at Your feet
But You have never broken one

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
You open up Your heart
Time and time and time again
You open up Your heart
Time and time and time again

verse.name: b3
verse.lines:
You give beauty for ashes
Garments of praise
You give infinite mercies
To those who fear Your name

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
You really enjoy me
You really are for me
Finally, I believe it
Finally, I receive it
